title: Cookie Policy
metaDescription: How cookies and browser storage are used on this site, and a statement that no analytics or advertising cookies are used.
intro: This policy explains how cookies and similar browser storage technologies are used on this website.
In short: no analytics or advertising cookies are used on this site. There is only the functional browser storage needed for the site to work.

sections.heading: What cookies and browser storage are
paragraphs: A cookie is a small text file that a website saves in your browser. Local storage (localStorage) is a browser area used for a similar purpose that is not sent to the server automatically.
Both store data on your device; the main difference is that cookies are sent to the server with every request, while local storage stays on your device.

sections.heading: What this site uses
paragraphs: The site uses browser storage for functional purposes only:
bullets: Saving the text you write in the contact form as a draft and restoring it when you return to the page
Keeping the email address you enter in the newsletter field in your browser in the same way

sections.heading: Is consent required?
paragraphs: Because only the functional storage strictly necessary to provide the service is used, no separate cookie consent banner is shown on this site.
If an analytics or marketing technology is added in the future, it will only run after your explicit consent has been obtained, and this policy will be updated.

sections.heading: How to clear it
paragraphs: You can remove all local data stored by this site by deleting site data in your browser settings. When you browse in a private or incognito window, the data is deleted automatically when you close the window.
Deleting this data doesn't stop the site from working; only your saved form drafts will be lost.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: When the technologies used on the site change, this policy is updated and the date at the top of the page is refreshed.
